title: Shanahan Previews Commanders Matchup, Injury Updates
headline: Deebo Samuel Sr. and Garret Wallow are ruled out for Sunday's Commanders game, Mykel Williams and Gracen Halton are questionable, and Brock Purdy gets strong praise from Shanahan.
summary: Shanahan opened with the injury report for Sunday's Week 6 game against Washington: Deebo Samuel Sr. and Garret Wallow are out, while Mike Evans, Gracen Halton, Mykel Williams, and Upton Stout are listed as questionable. He said questionable designations are precautionary, applied to any player with lingering concerns. A returning player's status, which reporters asked about, will be determined Monday, and Shanahan called the return from an injury that looked serious early on 'really impressive.' Kaelon Black is not on the injury report but is away from the team for the birth of his child, and Shanahan said the team was expecting that absence even though Black had been optimistic about playing. Shanahan spent much of the session reflecting on his 2015 Falcons experience and his own perspective on winning streaks. He praised Brock Purdy's competitiveness, comparing his consistency to Matt Ryan's and saying Purdy plays to win, not for his passer rating, and that Purdy has become more aggressive against Raheem Morris's secondary. He also credited Sebastian Valdez, who initially missed the roster, as a player the team gambled on and was lucky to keep.
